title: [YSQL] "FATAL:  Illegal state: Not the leader" error when start an RF 1 cluster with PostgreSQL enabled
body:
When starting a YugaByte DB cluster with PostgreSQL enabled with replication factor of 1, a fatal error is hit.

```
$ ./bin/yb-ctl --rf 1 start --enable_postgres
018-11-09 10:47:06,971 INFO: Starting master-1 with:
/Users/robert/code/yugabyte/build/debug-clang-dynamic-enterprise/bin/yb-master --fs_data_dirs "/tmp/yugabyte-local-cluster/node-1/disk-1,/tmp/yugabyte-local-cluster/node-1/disk-2" --webserver_interface 127.0.0.1 --rpc_bind_addresses 127.0.0.1 --v 0 --version_file_json_path=/Users/robert/code/yugabyte/build/debug-clang-dynamic-enterprise --callhome_enabled=false --replication_factor=1 --yb_num_shards_per_tserver 2 --master_addresses 127.0.0.1:7100 >"/tmp/yugabyte-local-cluster/node-1/disk-1/master.out" 2>"/tmp/yugabyte-local-cluster/node-1/disk-1/master.err" &
2018-11-09 10:47:07,006 INFO: Starting tserver-1 with:
/Users/robert/code/yugabyte/build/debug-clang-dynamic-enterprise/bin/yb-tserver --fs_data_dirs "/tmp/yugabyte-local-cluster/node-1/disk-1,/tmp/yugabyte-local-cluster/node-1/disk-2" --webserver_interface 127.0.0.1 --rpc_bind_addresses 127.0.0.1 --v 0 --version_file_json_path=/Users/robert/code/yugabyte/build/debug-clang-dynamic-enterprise --callhome_enabled=false --tserver_master_addrs 127.0.0.1:7100 --memory_limit_hard_bytes 1073741824 --yb_num_shards_per_tserver 2 --redis_proxy_bind_address 127.0.0.1 --cql_proxy_bind_address 127.0.0.1 --pgsql_proxy_bind_address 127.0.0.1 --local_ip_for_outbound_sockets 127.0.0.1 --use_cassandra_authentication=false >"/tmp/yugabyte-local-cluster/node-1/disk-1/tserver.out" 2>"/tmp/yugabyte-local-cluster/node-1/disk-1/tserver.err" &
The files belonging to this database system will be owned by user "robert".
This user must also own the server process.

The database cluster will be initialized with locale "en_US.UTF-8".
The default database encoding has accordingly been set to "UTF8".
The default text search configuration will be set to "english".

Data page checksums are disabled.
...
I1109 10:47:08.028630 47521792 async_initializer.cc:73] Starting to init ybclient
I1109 10:47:08.094303 47521792 async_initializer.cc:79] Successfully built ybclient
W1109 10:47:09.547744 168293824 ybccmds.c:46] Ignoring source database 'template1' when creating database 'template0'
2018-11-09 10:47:09.549 PST [93223] FATAL:  Illegal state: Not the leader. Local UUID: a211590f8cde46ff90570e6a6e714113, Consensus state: current_term: 0 config { opid_index: -1 peers { permanent_uuid: "a211590f8cde46ff90570e6a6e714113" member_type: VOTER last_known_private_addr { host: "127.0.0.1" port: 7100 } cloud_info { placement_cloud: "cloud1" placement_region: "datacenter1" placement_zone: "rack1" } } }
2018-11-09 10:47:09.549 PST [93223] STATEMENT:  CREATE DATABASE template0 IS_TEMPLATE = true ALLOW_CONNECTIONS = false;

child process exited with exit code 1
```
The cluster can be started without issue when RF is greater than 1.
